notes.title: Patch 1.8.5.3 🗡️
notes.content:
Hello guys, good news!

The Patch 1.8.5.3 for The Land Beneath Us is here!

A brand-new "Blessing & Curse" pack is now available in the Soul Shard Shop, unlocked after completing the main story. This update brings new weapons, relics, chips, and a challenging new quest. We've also added fresh animations, refined balance and status effects, and fixed numerous bugs to improve gameplay across the board. We're also working on a Resume feature, allowing players to leave or exit the game and continue later from where they left off.
 
New Contents:

Blessing & Curse pack
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/20878ae796d35a1d4ad17a799c51254bd60f134e.png"]The soul shard shop unlocks after completing the main story.  A new pack, "Blessing & Curse” has now been released! It includes:


Weapons

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/c1d8ea413efd478131e239fb0e03c534ee5addd9.png"]

Blessing Katana

Cost: 20,000 soul shards

Description: Hit an enemy 1 tile away, then move to the tile behind them. When hitting the enemy, 10% chance to receive a random buff for 3 turns. Max Level: Increases to 20% chance.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/de38a44a16a70838a797a13308ec4e9e10b77863.gif"]

Blessing Sniper

Cost: 20,000 soul shards

Description: Fire a shot 5 tiles away. Damage depends on the hit range. 10% chance to gain a random buff for 3 turns when hitting an enemy. Max level: Fires a shot 7 tiles away instead.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/5d22891816a68068c9964de57536b7c7b8267b0d.gif"]



Curse Sniper

Cost: 20,000 soul shards

Description: Fire a shot 7 tiles away. Damage depends on the hit range and status effect turns. 20% chance to gain a random buff for 2 turns when hitting an enemy. Curse: 20% chance to gain a random debuff for 2 turns when hitting an enemy. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/3a179b7b7c0df31af1f0aa5c506dd595bf0ac7ba.gif"]

Relics

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/a7ee937330eb8e75c97f614f2d0a5ff66faaef2c.png"]


Red Counting Box

Cost: 20,000 soul shards
Rarity: Epic

Description: You have a +5% critical chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% critical chance)(Max: x%)

Enhanced description: You have a +10% critical chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% critical chance)(Max: x%)

Yellow Counting Box

Cost: 20,000 soul shards
Rarity: Epic

Description: You have a +2.5% dodge chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% dodge chance)(Max: x%)

Enhanced description: You have a +5% dodge chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% dodge chance)(Max: x%)



Orange Counting Box

Cost: 20,000 soul shards
Rarity: Epic

Description: You have a +2.5% critical DMG chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% critical DMG)(Max: x%)

Enhanced description: You have a +5% critical DMG chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% critical DMG)(Max: x%)

Black Counting Box

Cost: 20,000 soul shards
Rarity: Legendary

Description: Increase other Counting Box limit effects by +10%.You have +1 base DMG per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x base DMG)

Enhanced description: Increase other Counting Box limit effects by +20%.You have +1 base DMG per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x base DMG)

Chips

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/d16406ca3c960aa8ed6493c4aa63a55dcdc0afc9.png"]


Random Buff

Cost: 20,000 soul shards
Lv.1 Description: Cast Random Buff. Applies 2 random buffs to self for 2 turns.

Fast Forward

Cost: 20,000 soul shards
Lv.1 Description: Cast Fast Forward. Resets all chips and teleport cooldown immediately.

Consume Wave

Cost: 30,000 soul shards

Lv.1 Description: Cast Consume Wave. Consumes all your buffs and debuffs to randomly deal 11 - 15 DMG per stack to all enemies.



Gloria

Cost: 30,000 soul shards
Lv.1 Description: Cast Gloria to self for 3 turns. Your attacks have a 25% chance to receive 3 Souls or Soul Shards.  
A Fierce Warrior King Quest

Unlock: Encounter Nuada
Objective: Kill Nuada
Reward: Unlock "Crimson Burning Blade”

Crimson Burning Blade

Description: Hit an enemy 1 tile away. Apply 1 Burn per 3 Lord souls and gain a 20% chance to consume the enemy's Burn stack to deal 5 DMG per stack. (Current: apply x Burn stacks)  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/ef8fd14237e6e7ae7e139424de3e4e867a9b9785.gif"]

Added a new status effect: Receive Souls Per Hit Chance Description: Your attacks have a x% chance to receive 3 Souls or Soul Shards.

Added 2 new Sven animations: Shooting by "Gun” and "Sniper”  

Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where Zero Sven might not spawn.

Fixed an issue where Nuada’s image in the Boss Archive was incorrect.

Fixed an issue where Chip Mode automatically switched from Manual to Auto when the chip was activated.

Fixed an issue where the Hidden Dagger relic had no effect on bosses.

Fixed an issue where the Nuada Ring relic didn’t heal for 5% of total damage.

Fixed an issue where the Adar Llwch Feather relic incorrectly applied the Bonus Damage status effect on a critical hit.

Fixed an issue where The Basher incorrectly increased the Bonus Damage status effect on every hit during a single turn.

Fixed an issue where removing the Provoking Mask did not reset the enemy's damage reduction.

Fixed an issue where the Thunder chip applied an incorrect amount of stun.

Fixed an issue where the Explosion chip displayed an incorrect image.

Fixed an issue where the Additional Flat Damage was calculated multiple times in a single turn.

Fixed an issue where a permanent status effect could be removed when using the Consume Wave chip.

Fixed an issue where the Permanent Immunity status effect displayed two icons when the player enhanced the Band of Immunity relic.

Fixed an issue where some status effect icons displayed incorrect values.

Fixed an issue where a status effect icon was not disabled after being used.

Fixed an issue where challenge conditions were not reset when entering another mode.

Balancing & Gameplay Changes:
Adjusted the maximum stack limit of the Shield Absorb status effect to 10.

Increased base damage of the sword-type weapons by +10%

Increased the impact damage by +50%

Increased the Hidden Boss’s HP and damage.
○ HP: 900 → 1470

○ Damage: 11 → 17

Increased the Hidden Boss chance in the Purple Moon mode
○ Lv. 1: 5% → 10%

○ Lv. 2: 5% → 20%

○ Lv. 3: 5% → 40%

○ Lv. 4: 10% → 60%

○ Lv. 5: 20% → 80%

○ Lv. 6: 30% → 100%

Increased the Burn status effect duration

Relic 

○ Pyro Reactor (Enhanced): 2 → 3 turns

Weapons

○ Agony Great Sword: 3 → 5 turns

○ Agony Raid Rapid: 3 → 5 turns

○ Agony Spear: 3 → 5 turns

○ The Rage of Brigit: 2 → 3 turns

○ Lv. 6: 30% → 100%

Chips

○ Fireball: 2 → 3 turns

○ Fire trap: 2 → 3 turns

○ Pyromaniac (per levels): 1/1/2/2/3/3/4/4/5/6 → 2/2/3/3/5/5/6/6/7/9 turns
Trap

○ Lava tile effect: 2 → 3 turns


Localization Updates: 
Fixed an issue where some words are typos in the French language.

Updated more information for the relics’ descriptions. 

Relics
Auto Loot System (Normal): On clearing a room, destroy all breakables in the room. +30% Bonus Gold and Bonus Souls. 

Auto Loot System (Enhanced): On starting a room, destroy all breakables in the room. +50% Bonus Gold and Bonus Souls. 

Guard Up (Enhanced): On starting a room, apply 1 Shield Absorb to yourself. 



Status effects
Burn Inflict Enhance: Your attacks have a x% chance to apply 3 Burns. 

Poison Inflict Enhance: Your attacks have a x% chance to apply 3 Poisons. 

Stun Inflict Enhance: Your attacks have a x% chance to apply 1 Stun. 

Blind Inflict Enhance: Your attacks have a x% chance to apply 1 Blind. 

Disarm Inflict Enhance: Your attacks have a x% chance to apply 1 Disarm. 

Mark Inflict Enhance: Your attacks have a x% chance to apply 3 Marks. 

Shield Absorb: Block DMG 1 time per stack. DMG taken will heal you instead. (Max: 10 stacks) 
Known Issues:
Sven can move onto the same tile as the lava totem in the Caorthannach room.

The cursed effect of the Cursed Auf's Revolver doesn't cancel when the weapon reaches its maximum level.

The mini-boss and boss have incorrect HP values.

The counter equipment doesn't work against moving enemies.

The Piggy Bank relic icon is missing its current value display.

The Provoking Mask doesn't update enemy damage data in Inspector Mode.

The status effect of an enhanced relic is not displayed in the Archive panel.

New Update:

 Added a new condition: Chance to encounter the hidden boss in Purple Moon mode.
 Added a new hidden boss: Nuadain Purple Moon mode.

Balancing & Gameplay Changes:

 Added a teleport cooldown when the player gets disarmed.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the player could walk while the background was still loading.
 Fixed an issue where the player could move during cutscenes.
 Fixed an issue where the background music played incorrectly.

notes.title: Patch Note 1.7.3
notes.content:
Implemented Steam cloud save
After opening chests, the items will now spawn between the player and the portal.
 
Bug Fixes:

Fixed the issue where some characters were missing in Traditional Chinese language.
Fixed the issue where East and West regions were inverted.
Fixed the issue where the visual display of Permanent Immunity was missing at the bottom left.
Fixed the issue where swapping Vel Armor with another relic and picking it up caused the player to lose HP.
Fixed the issue allowing players to pick duplicate relics.
Fixed the issue where slime/spider/hound animation froze after attacking player.
Fixed the issue where chest assets were not loaded.
Fixed the issue where Bloody Edge stack reset to zero when upgraded.
Fixed the issue where Overkill Spear did not trigger the Overkill relic correctly.
Fixed the issue where another final boss map didn't appear after completing the game.
Fixed the issue causing enemies to always have immunity.
Fixed the issue where Abyssal Dagger and Trinity Code could lead to incorrect chip cooldown.
Fixed the issue where the Skull Tech Warlock's spawn totem would sometimes appear in the lava/poison tile.
Fixed the issue where enemy kills with status effects were not being counted.
Fixed the resolution responsiveness issue of the main menu.
Fixed the scroll bar bug in the Moon World selection screen.
Fixed the looping sound issue when holding the button in the core upgrade menu.
Fixed the issue where player can duplicate relic when closing the swap item UI.

Localization Updates:

Updated Chinese localization.
Updated Thai localization.

Balancing & Gameplay Changes:

Units will not inflict stun again for 3 turns after the initial stun.
Updated the miniboss room (4 Kings) in TGA right wing.
Rebalanced the relics drop rate.
Adjusted the Zero Saber/Equilibrium to have a maximum stack of 10.
Adjusted HP calculations to reflect percentage changes when max HP is altered.


Fork (normal): When activating Overkill‚ you have a 25% chance to apply 1 Shield to self.
Fork (enhanced): When activating Overkill‚ you have a 50% chance to apply 1 Shield to self.


Basher (enhanced): When attacking a Stunned enemy‚ you deal +200% bonus damage. When attacking the enemy‚ you have a 10% chance to apply 2 Stun to the enemy.


Red Piggy Bank (normal): You gain base DMG corresponding to 2% of your gold. (Max: 15 base DMG)
Red Piggy Bank (enhanced): You gain base DMG corresponding to 5% of your gold. (Max: 15 base DMG)


Poison: At the end of the turn‚ deal DMG equal to 10% of max HP; against bosses‚ deal DMG equal to 5% of their max HP. (Ignore Shield)

Shield: Block DMG 1 time per stack. Stack will not decrease at the end of turn. (Max: 10 stacks)


Typo:

Green Piggy Bank (enhanced): You gain max HP corresponding to 10% of your highest gold. (Max: 100 max HP)

notes.title: Dev Blog #2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/d537b70dbd6a077f8d3fb6c5dcd8e09eb39d5b3d.jpg

Hello Underworld Dwellers,

6 days to go until the release, yes, the May 13, are you excited about it? [strike](You have to be excited ...) 😠[/strike]

Sorry, a bit rude, let's get back to the topic, today we're going to talk about two of the changes that we've made in game. Too much talking, wait, if you haven't joined our official The Land Beneath Us Discord for the Demo Speed Run Challenge... it's now the time (you may have a chance to win a key)! 😎

Download the Demo and Wishlist NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2131010/The_Land_Beneath_Us/

Okok, I should stop talking, let's get started!
[hr][/hr] 😔 It hurts, it really hurts ... 😔

[strike]My precious,[/strike] Vel Armor, our precious let's say, is nerfed. Balancing is always the problem that we want to improve so that we can provide an endless experience, generally speaking, we wanna offer you more choices in terms of relics and weapons instead of only focusing on getting the Vel Armor. 

So in the full game, the Vel Armor will only give you 50% to heal 1 HP, otherwise, you need to upgrade it to get the 100% healing. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/4de4ecada5e7f81f2b04ec3ad670449a49498393.png
[hr][/hr] 🤖 Do you think this is the end? No, never 🤖

We won't let you go like this, we wanna you, to retrieve more and more Soul Energies 😎 We are insatiable ahahaha. 

Anyway, we have added the World Customization after you finished the run in the area. As you can see in the screenshot below, there are maximum 5 levels. You have to complete the 1st level before moving on to the 2nd level. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/789fe8946f7971b241d775a6f111aa5b8de297a5.png
A higher level can give you more soul rewards and more difficulty. To get started, simply just add conditions on the right hand side to fill in the gauge point! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/8f3a769293e866b107c600be73875786935e0eb1.png
You can add as many conditions as you want, but you have to respect the maximum gauge points that you have in each level. From level 0 to level 1, you need and can accumulate a maximum of 5 gauge points, and 10 for level 2, and so on. Attention, some conditions may get you 3 gauge points when it's enabled! 

From level 0 to level 1 (I add more than 5 gauge points, but it's still at 5/5 as I'm in level 0)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/d59044349abb1dfcb73008346cbdca5bffaaeb61.png
From level 1 to level 2
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/b77221a9e25d3157b21adaedb4c6a53bd915ddae.png
Challenge yourself, fill in the Gauge Point and collect bonus soul energies! Are you up to the Challenge?
[hr][/hr] Thank you for your support! See you very soon!

Cheers,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/cef451a55593087d7456fbd0641656a1369a6244.jpg

notes.title: The Land Beneath Us: Unleash Mythic Mayhem in Annwn's Underworld!
notes.content:
Hello Underworld Dwellers,

PID Games publishing label from sunny South of France is partnering up with FairPlay Studios, an indie game development studio from sunny South of Asia, to bring you a unique blend of a turn-based rogue-lite dungeon crawler, wow that’s a mouthful!

Well, long story short, the game is called The Land Beneath Us and interestingly enough, it’s rooted in Welsh mythology. You get to unleash cool skill combos and wield stylish weaponry in Annwn's Underworld. The objective is to conquer the Seven Lords, save The Creator, and retrieve vital Soul-Tech.
 
We are delighted to announce that it is planned to be released next year! 

Watch the Gameplay Teaser and get teased lol
[previewyoutube=0AzgqWVboSo;full][/previewyoutube]

SYNOPSIS
The Land Beneath Us is a turn-based rogue-lite action dungeon crawler. Use powerful skill combos and stylish weaponry to battle your way through the Underworld known as Annwn. Enjoy challenging dynamic encounters and discover the mysteries of this mythological world.

KEY FEATURES
BATTLE THROUGH THE UNDERWORLD! 
Forged by The Creator, the Ultimate Soul Harvester (U.S.H) is crafted to gather Souls. Now armed with Soul-Technology, its mission is one of redemption. Explore The Underworld, engage, barter, or confront characters. Learn from their tales to shape your unique path. 

MASTER THE COMBOS! 
Overcome enemies with powerful abilities, executing customizable movement combinations. Plan strategically through short, action-packed levels to maximize hits on creatures! 

VARIED ARSENAL 
Strategize and wield a diverse array of weapons, from Blood Axes to Longinus Spears and Lazer Pistols. Equip different weapons in each slot for a dynamic hack 'n' slash journey through the Underworld. 

VARIED ARSENAL REPLAYABILITY FACTOR 
Enhance stats and abilities by collecting souls from defeated enemies as you explore each world. Enjoy direct combat? Boost your Weapon skill tree. Prefer a strategic approach? Unlock potent Combo Abilities to hit enemies from a distance. 

Developers: FairPlay Studios
